110420101.text: Paimon has a question. After the seed sprouts, will it grow into anything?

110420102.text: I don't know, but I feel the importance will lie in the method, not the end point.

110420103.text: Using alchemy to awaken otherworldy life in Teyvat would constitute a big leap in my understanding of the essence of life.

110420104.text: After awakening, even creation may be possible.

110420106.text: Aha... Still a little difficult to understand?

110420107.text: N—No! Paimon's got a brain! But what's the seed gonna become? Isn't that more interesting than whatever it was you were saying?

110420110.text: Well, if it turns out to be a delicious fruit, dinner's on me.

110420111.text: Yay! Paimon's holding you to it!

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the slimes to complete the experiment
Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

110420301.text: Great work. Did you feel anything out of the ordinary?

110420302.text: If you're injured, I have a few emergency potions ready.

110420305.text: Excellent. According to my observations, the manifestation of the external elemental flow is as expected, elemental reactions are normal. There's nothing out of the ordinary.

110420306.text: Now that we know that the external flow is manifesting normally, let's test the internal flow.

110420307.text: Internal flow... How do you test that?

110420308.text: It's very simple. I can use alchemy to create a potion that will extract elemental power.

110420309.text: If the elemental power is stored or accumulated physically within your body, this potion may elicit an elemental reaction.

110420801.text: An elemental life form from another world! As soon as we have strong evidence, this may end up subverting a lot of alchemical theories.

110420802.text: Albedo's research will see huge progress!

110420901.text: Doesn't sound very rigorous, surely there's another approach...

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the road and search for a Starsilver Catalyst

110420501.text: This is my campsite. I've added the materials we collected to the concoction.

110420502.text: While we are waiting, have a look over here.

110420503.text: My assistant Timaeus here is helping me with my research. I'm guessing you may have met in Mondstadt already?

110420504.text: Hello, I've just gotten hold of the data from your experiment. The report is already up on the board there.

110420505.text: Whoa! Look at all the data! You got all these results from one slime battle?

110420506.text: Haha, I wouldn't call them results. Inferences, and a few daring guesses perhaps.

110420507.text: I think the most rational direction would be to expound on the phylogenetic relationship between this Traveler and the slimes.

110420510.text: Hmm, consider: You don't have a Vision, but you can manipulate elemental energy. The slimes don't have Visions either, yet they, too, are able to manipulate the elements.

110420511.text: Following this line of thought, I'm sure we'll be able to establish a basis in fact.

110420512.text: Not bad for a point of entry, but strictly speaking, slimes are elemental life forms. In other words, beings consisting entirely of the elements.

110420513.text: A Cryo Regisvine, or even a Whopperflower might be a better analogy. But tracing back the phylogenetic relationships between plants and animals... You might have to trace back to the world's origins.

110420514.text: In that sense, things might get difficult, don't you think?

110420515.text: Uh! Yes sir. That sounds correct.

110420516.text: After all, we've got our primary data already. This Traveler is a visitor from another world.

110420517.text: #If it turned out that {M#he}{F#she} did have a phylogenetic relationship with this world... Now that really would be something, wouldn't it?

110420518.text: Ahhhh, it would! Apologies, I was so excited to get the data. I'll slow down a bit next time.

110420519.text: Speaking of data — to complete our research, we'll need some more. I'll be conducting analysis here for the time being. If you're keen for an update, just come and find me!

110420520.text: Great, I'll leave you to it.

110420521.text: Hmm, looks like the potion's ready. I'll try a little first. If all goes well, I'll hand it over to you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take the potion from the desk

110420601.text: I've just tried some, it's in line with my expectations.

110420602.text: Remember to keep calm at all times, and breathe deeply if you feel unwell.

110420603.text: I'll be noting down all observable results and data points.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

110420701.text: #Tasty? You've got a funny look on your face, {NICKNAME}!

110420704.text: #You said you tried some already! You sure it was ready? What happened to {M#him}{F#her}?

110420705.text: Hmm? Oh, this was the result I was expecting, and a very positive one at that.

110420706.text: This potion channels elemental power into the body. Under normal circumstances, a repelling reaction is to be expected.

110420707.text: But if the internal elemental flow is unimpeded, you'll only experience momentary discomfort. Once the flow is complete, there won't be any other effects.

110420708.text: So you knew you'd be sick and still drank some?

110420709.text: Eh-he, it was my own concoction of course, only natural for me to be the guinea pig.

110420611.text: Mm-hmm, in line with my expectations. Ready to drink.

110420612.text: Remember to keep calm at all times, and breathe deeply if you feel unwell.
